research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Meter Feeder is focused on developing an autonomous vehicle parking system, which involves a parking system server that communicates electronically with autonomous vehicles. The server processes parking location requests and identifies suitable parking zones, aligning with Meter Feeder's mission to provide cost-effective parking payment and enforcement solutions. This research highlights their commitment to integrating advanced technology into parking management, enhancing efficiency for individuals and government agencies.

overview_description.description: Meter Feeder's mission to provide a low cost payment and enforcement solution for small to mid-sized governments. A fast set up process and geolocation get new users paid and on their way fast.  MeterFeeder works with customers' current infrastructure. Users don't need to purchase any new meters or kiosks, growing the base of people more willing to pay via electronic payments.

about_short_description.short_description: Meter Feeder provides a low cost parking payment and enforcement solution for individuals and small to mid-sized government agencies.

product.name: Meter Feeder App
product.description: A mobile application that allows individuals to pay for parking by entering their license plate and credit card information, enabling remote payment and time extension.

product.name: Meter Reader App
product.description: A mobile application for parking enforcement officers to verify parking payments and issue tickets using a mobile device.

product.name: Ticket Monitor Platform
product.description: A platform that tracks and manages parking tickets for fleets, providing detailed reports and helping reduce ticket-related costs.

product.name: Free Vehicle Audit Service
product.description: A service providing a free audit of up to three vehicles to review parking ticket history and identify potential savings for fleet operators.

product.name: Municipal Parking Management Solutions
product.description: Software and services that enable municipalities to manage parking payments and enforcement at scale using mobile and digital tools.
